versions.changelog:
Initial release of google-search-console skill.

- Provides detailed guidance for analyzing Google Search Console (GSC) data, including performance metrics, indexing, technical insights, and best practices.
- Explains GSC terminology, key reports, workflows, and interpretation tips for clicks, impressions, CTR, and average position.
- Outlines methodologies for chart reading, trend investigation, report exporting, and data correlation.
- Summarizes title tag and meta description optimization, CTR benchmarks, and actionable next steps for common GSC issues and reports.
